+## Why
+In one process, each model must load one time only, and all users must share it, so that memory is not wasted. The router pool (`Resolution/ModelPool.swift`, `ResidencyHold.swift` in `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/`) does this today, but it is tied to router types. This task makes a pool in Extras that has no router types.
+
+## What to do
+Add `public actor ModelPool` with `ModelPool.shared` to the `ModelPool` target. Use the router pool as the source, and remove these tangles:
+1. Key: `ModelRef` + role (`.llm`, `.embedding`).
+2. Entry: an opaque `Sendable` model container. Do not use the router `LoadedLLMContainer` or `PooledContainer`. The router casts the container to its own type.
+3. Loader protocol: load by `ModelRef` and role only. Do not use `ModelSlot` (standard, flash, embedding). That is a router concept.
+4. Holds: one hold for each key. Do not group the charges by a router profile token (`residentProfiles: [ULID: [SlotCharge]]`). A user that is not the router must be able to acquire one model by identifier. The hold deinit queues a release on the pool (the same as `ResidencyHold`).
+5. `acquire` takes a loader. The pool uses the loader only when the key is not yet resident.
+6. Keep the resolve lock (`withResolveLock` on `AsyncSemaphore`) and the byte ledger (`residentFootprintBytes`, `residentKeys`, `drainPendingReleases`).
+7. Add a residency-change hook. The pool calls it when the set of resident models changes. The router uses it to resize its prompt cache. Memory fitting (`JointFit`) and the prompt cache sizing stay in the router.
+8. Keep each comment that tells why a construct is necessary.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+- [ ] Test: two callers acquire the same key at the same time. The loader runs one time only, and both callers get the same container.
+- [ ] Test: the model is evicted when the last hold is released, and not before.
+- [ ] Test: the residency-change hook runs on load and on eviction.
+- [ ] Test: the byte ledger is correct after load and after eviction.
+- [ ] The public API has doc comments. `swift test` passes. #model-pool #cross-repo
